headline: Attack on Titan 3 December 10
title: Attack on Titan 3 Release Date December 10 | PS5, Xbox, Switch 2, PC | Gaming News
video_script: Attack on Titan three from Koei Tecmo and Omega Force is coming on December tenth. It launches on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series, Switch 2 and PC through Steam. Pre-orders are open, with a Steelbook edition on physical platforms. Players with Attack on Titan two save data get a special in-game gift. Are you ready? Comment below!
description: Attack on Titan 3 (Koei Tecmo / Omega Force) launches December 10, 2026 on PS5, Xbox Series, Switch 2 and PC via Steam. Sources: Koei Tecmo America, Gematsu.
